t: Meeting Room - Share Recordings with Custom Access Permissions
html:
Meeting Room lets you share meeting recordings with clients, teammates, and other participants using a shareable link. You can control who can access a recording, set an expiration date, add passcode protection, and manage download and viewing permissions. Recipients can watch recordings directly in their browsers without downloading files or receiving attachments.

What Is Sharing Meeting Recordings?


Meeting Recording Sharing allows you to securely share recorded meetings directly from Eleva. Instead of downloading and sending recording files, you can generate a shareable link, specify who can access it, and customize what viewers can see or download.

Recording Access Options


Meeting Room provides three access levels to help you control who can view a shared recording. Choosing the appropriate access level ensures recordings are available to the intended audience.


Access OptionDescription
RestrictedOnly the recording owner and people explicitly granted access can open the recording.
Everyone with a signed-in accountUsers signed in to your Eleva sub-account can access the recording using its link.
Anyone with the linkAnyone with the recording link can view it without signing in, subject to any configured passcode.


You can also add multiple recipients by name and manage their access from the People with access list.


Customize Recording Sharing Settings


Recording-sharing settings allow you to determine how long a recording remains accessible and what viewers can do with it. These options are available under More settings, accessed through the gear icon in the sharing dialog.


Available settings include:


  • Expiration Date: Set the link to expire in 7, 30, or 90 days, or choose a custom expiration date.

  • Passcode: Enable a six-digit passcode to provide additional protection. You can copy the passcode together with the recording link.

  • Viewers Can Download: Allow or prevent viewers from downloading the recording.

  • Viewers Can See Transcript: Control whether the recording transcript is visible to viewers.

  • Viewers Can See Chat: Control whether viewers can access the meeting chat.


Click Save to apply your settings.


Email Notifications and Recording Playback


Eleva provides email notifications to help hosts and recipients access meeting recordings. Recipients can open shared recordings in their browsers and review available meeting information based on the permissions you configure.


Two email notifications are available:


  • Recording Shared: Recipients receive an email containing the shared recording link when you choose to notify them.



  • Recording Saved: Meeting hosts receive an email notification when their recording is saved.



When accessing a shared recording, viewers can:

  • Watch the meeting recording directly in their browser.

  • View and search the transcript, when available and permitted.

  • Navigate to specific moments using the transcript.

  • View meeting chat, when permitted.

  • Review meeting summaries and next steps when generated and included in the shared view.

  • Download the recording if downloading is enabled.

How to Share Meeting Room Recordings


You can share recordings directly from the Recordings list or an individual recording's detail page. Configuring access and viewing permissions before distributing the link helps ensure recipients have the intended level of access.


  1. Navigate to Meeting Room in the old UI and Client Apps > Meeting Room in the new UI.

  2. Open My room and locate the Recordings list.

  3. Find the recording you want to share and click the Share icon. You can also open the recording and access its sharing options from the detail page.

  4. In the sharing dialog, enter the names of the people you want to add and select the recipients.

  5. To email the selected recipients, enable Notify people and click Send.

  6. Under General access, select your preferred access option:

    • Restricted

    • Everyone with a signed-in account

    • Anyone with the link

  7. Click the gear icon to open More settings. Configure the expiration date, passcode, and viewing permissions as needed, then click Save.

  8. Click Copy link or Copy link & passcode, depending on your configuration, to copy the sharing information.

  9. Click Done to close the sharing dialog.

Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Do recipients need to install any software to watch a recording?

No. Shared recordings can be viewed directly in a web browser, provided the recipient meets the configured access requirements.


Q: Why is the transcript unavailable for a shared recording?

The transcript may not have been generated, or the recording owner may have disabled transcript access. Recording a meeting does not automatically generate a transcript; transcription must be enabled during the meeting.


Q: Can I change access permissions after sharing a recording?

Yes. You can reopen the recording's sharing dialog to review and manage access settings.


Q: Are meeting summaries and next steps always visible to recipients?

No. These details are available when they have been generated and are included in the shared recording view.
